mapper.select: select * from comment_tb where b_idx=#{ b_idx } order by cmt_idx desc
select * from ( select rank() over(order by cmt_idx desc) as no, c.* from (select * from comment_tb where b_idx=#{ b_idx }) c ) where no between #{ start } and #{ end }
select nvl(count(*),0) from comment_tb where b_idx=#{ b_idx }
select * from comment_tb where cmt_idx=#{ cmt_idx }
mapper.insert: insert into comment_tb values( seq_comment_tb_cmt_idx.nextVal, #{ cmt_content }, #{ cmt_ip }, sysdate, #{ b_idx }, #{ mem_idx }, #{ mem_name } )
mapper.update: update comment_tb set cmt_content = #{ cmt_content }, cmt_ip = #{ cmt_ip }, cmt_regdate=sysdate where cmt_idx=#{ cmt_idx }
mapper.delete: delete from comment_tb where cmt_idx=#{ cmt_idx }
